name: Meclinertant
summary: Meclinertant (SR-48692) is a drug which acts as a selective, non-peptide antagonist at the neurotensin receptor NTS1, and was the first non-peptide antagonist developed for this receptor. It is used in scientific research to explore the interaction between neurotensin and other neurotransmitters in the brain, and produces anxiolytic, anti-addictive and memory-impairing effects in animal studies.

fact.en: Developed by Sanofi, it was the first non-peptide blocker of the neurotensin receptor. Neurotensin itself is a small brain peptide first isolated in 1973 from cow brain.
fact.zh: 它由賽諾菲研發，是第一個非胜肽類的神經降壓素受體阻斷劑。神經降壓素是一種小型腦部胜肽，在1973年首次從牛腦中分離出來。
